factual.note: PASS for conservative gross-form whole-plant reconstruction. Naked dominant axis, repeatedly divided lateral sprays and grouped elongate terminal pairs are present; no broad leaf planes. Complete basal form, color, size, seven sprays and 40 pairs remain artistic. Fine within-pair torsion and microscopic anatomy are not resolved or claimed; this is not a taxonomically exact reproductive specimen model.

sources.observation: The right panel is Abbe/Banks Psilophyton reconstruction, not the left Aglaophyton panel or its scale bar. Dominant overtopping axes, divided lateral systems and grouped terminal capsules are the relevant evidence. This is a reconstruction, not an intact specimen.

sources.observation: Primary text supports dichotomizing fertile branches and paired elongated fusiform sporangia. It describes intertwined pairs and larger typical clusters; model counts and dimensions are deliberately artistic, not those measured fossils.

sources.observation: Corroborative review associates P. dawsonii with Gensel, distinguishes P. crenulatum/Dawson, and cautions about incomplete fossils. Not the sole primary authority.

source_and_concept_review.concept: Genuine three-panel concept inspected. It initially has sparse single terminal pairs, a thick tree-like axis and large base; frozen correction directs repeatedly dichotomized grouped fertile sprays and smaller conjectural anchorage. Final geometry follows those corrections.

component_review: Fresh source connectivity gives272 closed components, including80capsules and80necks. Decoded GLB independently yields60palette2+20palette3 capsule components.
Actual fork construction is seven lateral systems of15branch tubes each (three binary levels), with the106th21-vertex tube the unequal apical branch; source and top pixels agree.
Forty terminal pairs are the model count, not a fossil count. All connected components are closed; intended intersecting junction volumes are not treated as a universal zero-intersection failure.

specification.dimension_semantics: Original scale.art_target_bounds_blender_xyz_m is explicitly an art target, not a hard exported bbox interval. Scalar shape parameters specify design construction and are not silently turned into exact bbox thresholds. The one explicit shaft_radius_range_m interval is separately checked, without inventing a tolerance.
